title: Force-Placed Insurance Notice Checker
description: Checks a lender-placed insurance event against the 12 CFR 1024.37 notice sequence: the 45-day advance first notice with its prescribed content set, the reminder notice at least 15 days before the charge and at least 30 days after the first notice, the no-evidence precondition, the 15-day cancel-and-refund clock with pro-rata overlapping-coverage refund, and a values-only premium benchmark against the borrower alternative quote. Never labels a premium reasonable; missing values are refused.

first_notice_date.description: Date the written first notice was delivered or mailed. Required.

reminder_notice_date.description: Date the reminder notice was delivered or mailed. Required.

charge_date.description: Date the force-placed premium charge was assessed. Required.

charged_premium_amount.description: Premium charge assessed for the coverage period. Required, non-negative.

charge_coverage_start.description: Start of the period the charged premium covers. Required.

charge_coverage_end.description: End of the period the charged premium covers. Required, not before the start.

alternative_quote_amount.description: Optional borrower-provided alternative-quote premium for the values-only benchmark table; the benchmark refuses when it is missing.

evidence_of_continuous_coverage_date.description: Optional date evidence of continuous compliant coverage was received; triggers the 15-day cancel-and-refund evaluation.

borrower_coverage_start.description: Start of the borrower’s own hazard coverage period; required to compute the pro-rata refund when evidence is present.

borrower_coverage_end.description: End of the borrower’s own hazard coverage period.

cancellation_date.description: Optional date the force-placed coverage was cancelled.

refund_date.description: Optional date the refund was sent.

notice_mail_class.description: Optional mail class enum: first_class, certified, registered, priority_express, other. Only a class not less than first-class satisfies the mailing rule.

first_notice_content_items.description: Optional JSON array of content-item keys present on the first notice (c2_i through c2_xi); when supplied, all eleven items are required.

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_force_placed_notice
mcp_tool_definition.description: Checks a lender-placed insurance event against the 12 CFR 1024.37 notice sequence: the 45-day advance first notice with its prescribed content set, the reminder notice at least 15 days before the charge and at least 30 days after the first notice, the no-evidence precondition, the 15-day cancel-and-refund clock with pro-rata overlapping-coverage refund, and a values-only premium benchmark against the borrower alternative quote. Never labels a premium reasonable; missing values are refused.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface.
author: PostOakLabs

elements.requirement: written first notice delivered or mailed at least 45 days before the premium charge is assessed
reminder notice delivered or mailed at least 15 days before the premium charge is assessed
reminder notice not delivered or mailed until at least 30 days after the first notice

by the end of the 15-day period beginning on the reminder delivery date the servicer has not received evidence of continuous compliant coverage (a charge assessed despite such evidence is not permitted)
elements.note: no evidence of continuous coverage reported as received

elements.requirement: the first notice sets forth the information required by the content paragraph (all eleven enumerated items)
elements.note: first_notice_content_items not supplied; content checklist not evaluated

elements.requirement: mailed notices use a class of mail not less than first-class mail
elements.note: notice_mail_class not supplied; mailing check not evaluated

elements.requirement: charges related to force-placed insurance must be bona fide and reasonable (the node reports the comparison values only)
elements.note: values_only_comparison: the node reports charged vs alternative-quote values and never labels a premium reasonable or unreasonable

premium_benchmark.note: values_only_comparison: the node reports charged vs alternative-quote values and never labels a premium reasonable or unreasonable
